sasha: Heads-up — on-boarding 'heliotrope-7b' converted from Gemma -> Qwen. After int4 quant + our rotary per-head rescale the summarization Rouge-L dropped ~5 pts. Anyone seen headwise scale/ordering issues when converting across families?
ryan: Can you paste the minimal repro and exact flags?
sasha: Repro: local quantizer v0.9, blocksize=64, per_head_scale=True. Eval on 200 dev examples. Cmd used:
```bash
python eval.py --model ./out/heliotrope_qwen --quant=int4 --blocksize=64 --rotary=per_head --eval-set dev200
```
Outputs below.
maya: What's the FP16 baseline numbers?
sasha: FP16 baseline (same weights, no quant): Rouge-L 42.3
Naive int4 (global scale): Rouge-L 36.9
int4 + per-head naive rescale: Rouge-L 37.8
int4 + per-head WITH correct head alignment (manual swap heads 2<->5): Rouge-L 42.1
So this screams head-order mismatch rather than magnitude error.
ryan: That matches my past run — Gemma forks sometimes have a different head packing/order than Qwen. Did you run any headmap / fingerprint check during conversion?
sasha: I dumped a tiny fingerprint and it shows a permutation. Script used:
```py
# head_fingerprint.py (very tiny)
for i,h in enumerate(model.attn.heads):
    print(i, hash(h.weight[:4].cpu().numpy().tobytes()))
```
Found consistent 2 <-> 5 swap in the converted checkpoint.
morgan: @sasha can you push a small workaround in the convert path that detects head fingerprint permutations and remaps automatically? DevEx wants this as a gate for new family conversions.
sasha: I added a runtime shim for now: ROTARY_HEAD_REMAP env var, e.g. `ROTARY_HEAD_REMAP=[0,1,5,3,2,4,...]` — retested and FP16 parity restored. I'll open a PR to detect + auto-reorder during convert and add two unit tests (fingerprint detect + remap).
infra-bot: perf-ci: smoke-eval finished — int4 + remap: Rouge-L 42.0 :thumbsup:
maya: Next steps: add head-fingerprint step to the onboarding checklist and include a regression in Redwood Optimize's quant-sweep to catch permutations earlier. Also collect per-head activation stats during quant calibration so we can flag suspicious patterns.
ryan: Agreed. Also log the fingerprint hashes into model metadata (so Dedicated/Private conversions keep the mapping).
sasha: Will do, opening PR with tests and a short conversion doc. Posting link when ready.
